source: How often has a top 5 hit been written only by women in the last 10 years? It’s likely rarer than you think. … In 2021, there was one: Taylor Swift’s “All Too Well,” … In 2020, there was another. … But there were none in 2019… … Here are 2…
claim: The number of Top 5 hits written exclusively by women was 2 in 2010, 0 in each year from 2011 to 2019, and 1 in each of 2020, 2021 and 2022.

source: Only 118 of the 3,077 (3.8%) top 5 hits were written exclusively by women.
claim: 118 Top 5 hits (3.8%) were written exclusively by women.

source: But who performed those 118 songs? In almost all cases, women. Only 13 of those 118 were performed exclusively by men.
claim: Of the songs written exclusively by women, 89 were performed exclusively by women, 16 by mixed-gender groups and 13 exclusively by men.

source: Even if we expand our search to Top 5 hits written exclusively by women and performed by mixed-gender groups, that list of songs only grows to 29.
claim: Including mixed-gender performers, 29 songs written exclusively by women were performed by men or mixed-gender groups.

source: In almost all cases, women. Only 13 of those 118 were performed exclusively by men.
claim: 105 of the songs written exclusively by women were performed by at least one woman, and 13 were not.

source: If we look at the 118 songs written exclusively by women again, you’ll notice something else: the women who wrote more than half of these songs were also vocalists in the performing groups.
claim: 66 of the 118 songs written exclusively by women also credit at least one of their performers as a songwriter.
code: w.assign(k=w.title_artist_name.str.lower().str.strip()).merge(s[s.cut_two=='only women'].assign(k=lambda d: d.song_key.str.lower().str.strip())[['k']], on='k').groupby('k')['Songwriter is Artist'].apply(lambda x: (x==1).any()).agg(['sum','size'])

source: Only one had a songwriting team of all women. That one song - Kate Bush’s “Running Up that Hill (A Deal with God)” - was written in 1985 and only saw a resurgence because it was featured in the popular Netflix show Stranger Things
claim: Exactly one 2022 Top 5 song was written exclusively by women: “Running Up that Hill (A Deal with God)” by Kate Bush.

source: In 2022, Top 5 Billboard songs had 228 songwriting credits, but only 33 were women (14% of the total).
claim: Women accounted for 14.3% of 2022 Top 5 songwriting credits.

source: 2,272 of 3,077 (74%) songs were written entirely by an all-men songwriting team.
claim: 73.8% of Top 5 songs were written entirely by an all-men songwriting team.

claim: Both 2010 Top 5 songs written exclusively by women, “Mine” and “Today Was A Fairytale,” were written and performed by Taylor Swift.
